block.gungang.escort_bravo_spawn_gate: Escort BRAVO / Defense Spawn Hologram Gate
gungang.options.fontOversample.tip: Integer 1–8; default 6. Raster resolution of the selected TTF, without changing text size. Higher values use more memory and initial rasterization time. Saving reloads resources.
gungang.options.fontSmoothing.tip: On by default. Linear filtering for monochrome fonts with resolution above 1x, including resource-pack TTF fonts. Colored bitmap fonts are unaffected. Disable for sharper pixel edges. Saving reloads resources.
gungang.options.hudTextSize.tip: 100–150%; default 150%. Enlarges player names and health. 100% and 150% use integer screen scales.
gungang.options.hudBoldText.tip: Bold names and health using the normal font. Disabled for the custom TTF to preserve its original outlines without overlapping glyphs.
gungang.options.customFont.tip: Place a TTF in config/gungang/fonts to use it. An empty folder uses bundled Galmuri11 Bold. Disable to restore the normal game/resource-pack font. Force Unicode uses the normal Unicode font.
gungang.options.fontFile.tip: Filename inside config/gungang/fonts, e.g. MyFont.ttf. Leave empty to select the first TTF in filename order. Save to apply. After adding or replacing a file, press F3+T. Missing or invalid files fall back to bundled Galmuri11 Bold.
gungang.options.teamHud.tip: Show teammate portraits, health and weapons at the top left, with the same width as your HUD. Only slots and health bars have translucent backgrounds.
gungang.options.killLog.tip: Right-aligned face/name KILLED or DIED notices below the large timer. Up to five notices for eight seconds.
gungang.options.teamSilhouettes.tip: Show teammates through walls. Only server-tracked players can be displayed.
gungang.options.hudOffsetX.tip: Distance from the left edge (0–4096). One unit is two framebuffer pixels, independent of GUI scale.
gungang.options.hudOffsetY.tip: Distance from the bottom edge (0–4096). One unit is two framebuffer pixels. Higher moves up.
gungang.options.minimumEffectVolume.tip: 0–100%, default 16%. Floor for wall transmission. Distance, source volume and mute controls remain effective.
gungang.options.keyBindings.tip:
Change bindings in Minecraft's 'GunGangRealistic - Offhand Items' category.
G: attack once and return. H: use and return; hold for continuous-use items.
gungang.options.title: GunGangRealistic Settings
gungang.options.autoSprint.tip:
Sprint automatically while moving forward.
Pressing fire or aim stops the sprint so the gun can be used.
gungang.options.shooterHud.tip:
Show portrait, name, health and slot 1/offhand items.
Hides vanilla hotbar, hearts, XP and food bars. Independent of acoustics.
gungang.options.hint.3: Font changes reload resources on save.
gungang.options.defaults.tip: Reset drafts on ALL tabs. Save to apply.
gungang.options.invalid: Fix invalid values on all tabs before saving.
gungang.options.saveFailed: Save failed. Check the log and file permissions.
gungang.options.hint.0: Save to apply. Volume: 100% keeps the original level, 0% mutes.
gungang.options.hint.1: TaCZ keeps its own distance and silencer settings. Lists are comma-separated; leave empty to clear.
gungang.options.hint.2: Turn off the shooter HUD to restore the vanilla hotbar. Teams follow the server scoreboard.
gungang.options.enabled.tip: Enable distance attenuation, wall transmission, diffraction approximation and filtering.
gungang.options.lowPass.tip: Reduce high frequencies behind obstacles. Requires OpenAL EFX.
gungang.options.diffraction.tip: Search for clear paths around an obstacle. Increases CPU work.
gungang.options.wallStrength.tip: 0–4; default 1. Gentler FPS-style wall loss. A visible body sample releases occlusion. Zero disables wall loss.
gungang.options.smoothingSeconds.tip: 0.01–1; default 0.10. Higher values smooth changes more slowly.
gungang.options.referenceDistance.tip: 0.25–16 blocks; default 2. Ordinary sounds retain near-field volume. Does not affect TaCZ.
gungang.options.rolloff.tip: 0.1–4; default 1. Higher values attenuate ordinary sounds faster. Does not affect TaCZ.
gungang.options.updatesPerTick.tip: Integer 1–128; default 12. More frequent updates for busy scenes cost more CPU.
gungang.options.maxTraceDistance.tip: Integer 16–192 blocks; default 96. Wall effects are skipped beyond this range.
gungang.options.diffractionRadius.tip: Integer 1–8 blocks; default 4. Searches 1, 2, 4 and 8 block steps up to this value.
gungang.options.excludedSounds.tip:
Example: minecraft:entity.player.hurt, tacz:*
Exact event IDs or namespace:*. tacz:* also excludes packs using TaCZ's base sound event.
gungang.options.materialOverrides.tip:
Example: minecraft:stone=18, minecraft:glass=7
Use block ID=number from 0 to 120. Higher values transmit less sound.
gungang.options.fontOffsetX.tip: -8 to 8, default 0. Moves all custom TTF glyphs horizontally. Positive moves right; decimals supported.
gungang.options.fontOffsetY.tip: -8 to 8, default 1. Moves all custom TTF glyphs vertically. Increase if text sits too high. Positive moves down; HUD text scaling also applies.
gungang.options.footstepVolume.tip: 0–300%, default 100%. Adjusts step/footstep events while retaining distance, occlusion and game volume settings.
gungang.options.weaponVolume.tip: 0–300%, default 100%. TaCZ gun sounds and recognized firing, reloading, bow, crossbow, trident and attack events. Custom event names or engines may not be detected. Exclusions take priority.
gungang.options.footstepOcclusion.tip: Disable wall loss and muffling for footsteps. Distance, volume and water effects remain.
gungang.options.waterEffects.tip: Apply water-path and air-water boundary loss. High-frequency attenuation follows the low-pass setting.
gungang.options.compass.tip: Show eight compass directions, one-degree headings and enemy gunshot bearings above your health bar. Markers last 2.5 seconds.
gungang.nbt.empty: Hold an item in your main hand to copy its NBT.
gungang.nbt.copied: Copied the complete item NBT for %s.
gungang.controls.remove.tip: Remove this control and unbind it. Removed controls stay listed, marked as Removed.
gungang.controls.restoreRemoved.tip: Restore every removed control with its default key.
gungang.controls.restore.tip: Restore this control with its default key.
gungang.controls.removed.tip: This control was removed. Use the ↺ button on the right to restore it.
gungang.controls.backup.save.tip: Save the current key bindings and removed controls to config/gungang_acoustics-keybinds.json, replacing the previous save.
gungang.controls.backup.load.tip: Load the saved key bindings. Controls missing from the save, e.g. from mods added later, keep their current key.
gungang.controls.backup.failed: Could not use the key binding file
